audience: field-service businesses that manage orders, job sites and ordering parties in AuftragsDesk

useCases.title: Check which orders are still open for an ordering party
useCases.text: List the orders of an ordering party, filtered by status. Open one order to see its appointment and the staff assigned to it.

useCases.title: See which orders changed since yesterday
useCases.text: List the orders that changed since a given time, newest change first. Open one to read its current status and description.

useCases.title: Find a job site and its contact person
useCases.text: Search the customers, which are the job sites, by part of their name. Read the address and contact person of the site you need.

useCases.title: Look up an ordering party before you place an order
useCases.text: List the ordering parties, sorted by name, and open one to read its address and contact person.

useCases.title: Add a new job site and open an order there
useCases.text: Create a customer for an ordering party. Then create an order for that customer with a description, and AuftragsDesk assigns the order number.

useCases.title: Change the status of an order
useCases.text: Set an order to a new status, for example scheduled, in progress, completed or cancelled. A change that the app does not allow is refused.
